name: modelica-language-server
author: Andreas Heuermann, Osman Karabel, Evan Hedbor, PaddiM8

modelica.libraries.description: List of paths to Modelica library root directories to load on startup.

scripts.postinstall: cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install && cd ..
scripts.test:server: cd server && npx mocha --require $(node -e "process.stdout.write(require.resolve('tsx/cjs'))") src/test/**/*.test.ts src/project/test/**/*.test.ts src/util/test/**/*.test.ts src/analysis/test/**/*.test.ts
scripts.all: npm run postinstall && npm run esbuild && npm run lint && npm run test:server && npm run test:e2e && npm run vscode:prepublish
scripts.version:patch: npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm --prefix ./client version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm --prefix ./server version patch --no-git-tag-version
scripts.version:minor: npm version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm --prefix ./client version minor --no-git-tag-version && npm --prefix ./server version minor --no-git-tag-version
scripts.version:major: npm version major --no-git-tag-version && npm --prefix ./client version major --no-git-tag-version && npm --prefix ./server version major --no-git-tag-version
